svg.title: Nested-mask origin reduction of BuseyBench qwen3-8-2-4t-a95b
svg.desc: High-contrast reduction of the skin-texture rect in qwen3-8-2-4t-a95b.svg: the same feDropShadow group (an outer layer) containing the same faceMask-masked rect (an inner masked layer), with the feTurbulence fill replaced by solid red and opacity 0.14 raised to 1. Correct output: the face silhouette is entirely red on a blue field over a yellow base, with the soft drop shadow beneath it. If the inner mask is applied against the outer layer's capture origin instead of root device space, the red silhouette lands displaced: yellow shows through the face and red spills onto the blue field.
